name: pi-openai-codex-image
description: OpenAI Codex/ChatGPT OAuth image-generation tool for the pi coding agent. Registers openai_codex_generate_image (single, supports img2img) and openai_codex_generate_images (batch), powered by the OAuth-backed chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/images endpoints. Uses the openai-codex auth entry from ~/.pi/agent/auth.json and persists returned base64 images to ACB uploads.
